text:
zoe: Heads-up — planning a short maintenance to patch NIC microcode + soft-reboot GPU drivers in eu-south on Mon 2025-10-13 00:30-02:30 UTC. We'll do 3-rack cohorts with staggered start times and a small hot-backfill. Expected impact: brief task evictions, short p95 latency spikes, possible short queueing.
carlos: Can we avoid touching premium-dedicated tenants? Last time switching caused queue jitter.
mei: Yes — plan is to pin premium-dedicated to eu-south-dedicated-standby and mark them as unschedulable on affected racks. We'll also spin up a temporary hot-backfill (eu-temp-hot) with 7 nodes.
leo: Shop-floor ask: BGP egress tweak? I'd prefer we flip a secondary egress at T+5m to reduce ARP relearn windows.
zoe: Sequence below — cohorts of 5 nodes/rack, 10m gap between cohorts, abort conditions included.

```
# runbook
prep:
  pin-tenants --group premium-dedicated --target eu-south-dedicated-standby
  scale-up --pool eu-temp-hot --nodes 7 --duration 3h
  preheat-kv --strategy progressive --batch 20%
cohort-loop:
  for rack in rack01 rack02 rack03:
    cordon $rack --grace 300
    drain $rack --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir
    try-soft-driver-reload $rack || reboot $rack
    kvseed --pool eu-temp-hot --progressive
    smoke-tests --tags latency,queue
post:
  demote eu-temp-hot
  unpin-tenants
```

carlos: Cost estimate: ~850 USD for reserves + burst. Finance: need explicit signoff if >$800. @opsbot please open FIN ticket.
opsbot: Created MAINT-5566 and FIN-8899. Notified finance@redwood.
mei: SRE oncall (leo) will run cohort smoke and has abort authority. Abort if p95 >230ms for >3m, or pod eviction rate >3%, or node rejoin failures >1 per cohort.
leo: I'll run dry-run cordon at T-45m and a BGP swap test at T-30m. If fallback routes trigger >3 times we pause.
zoe: Communication: we'll post customer note tomorrow with explicit reserved tenant callout and update status page during window. Template: "Planned maintenance Oct 13 00:30-02:30 UTC. Short, transient latency and evictions possible; no data loss. Reserved customers pinned to standby."
carlos: One more: log smart-routing fallback counts and tag traces with maintenance-id MAINT-5566 for postmortem.
mei: Good idea — I'll add logging and an alert if fallback >10 events in 30m.
zoe: Final readiness check at T-60. If green, start at 00:30 UTC. :calendar:
